g.text: High-Performance Direct File-to-Core Streaming, Profile QA, Decoupled Upgrade, and Harmonization Cascade
Ingests diverse social science survey XML/JSON
• European social science study waves (e.g. CSO, ESS)
QA scorecard, URN minting & decoupled upgrade
• Checks existing batch receipt in database
• Plan halts if errors or quarantine flagged
• Archivist can review YAML before committing
Direct stream into normalized ReQuest tables
• Avoids duplicating XML in PostgreSQL JSONB
• Zero storage bloat & zero WAL explosion
• All entities and frequencies commit together
• Automatic complete rollback on any error
• Fast SQL index scans on (datafile, var, code)
• ON DELETE CASCADE purges core tables
• Detailed receipt: created vs reused URNs
• Flags identical URNs with divergent hashes
• Clusters question items across survey waves
• Anchors variables to ELSST / CESSDA concepts
Decouples abstract concepts from concrete survey questions and dataset columns
Controlled Vocabulary Anchor: CESSDA ELSST Thesaurus #c4820
• QuestionItem: "En politique, on parle de gauche et de droite..." (urn:ddi:fr.cdsp:qi-lr-fr:1.0.0)
Execute all stages automatically in a single reproducible CLI invocation
Receipt recorded in request_ddi_ingestbatch with full rollback provenance list.
Key performance & structural gains of the Phase 2 pipeline
Direct file-to-core streaming eliminates storing raw XML/JSONB rows in PostgreSQL,
reducing table and WAL storage footprint by over 50%.
Separates reusable question items from study-specific empirical observation counts
Guarantees universal referential integrity across all DDI entities with ON DELETE CASCADE,
enabling O(1) type resolution and clean polymorphic foreign keys.
Question wording, labels, and interviewer instructions stored in PostgreSQL JSONB
with deterministic canonical hashing for fast drift detection.
FAIRwDDI Lifecycle • WP3 ST3 Implementation of DDI Architecture for ReQuest • Centre des Données Socio-Politiques (CDSP), Sciences Po / CNRS
Canonical Agency: fr.cdsp • Standard: DDI 4.0 / DDI-CDI / DDI-Lifecycle 3.3
